title: Opioid Edit Limits of the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit
content:
Three figures govern the opioid edits of the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit, and all six networks set them alike.

| | Northbridge Performance Network | Northbridge Essential Network | Northbridge National Network | Northbridge Preferred Savings Network | Northbridge Retail90 Network | Northbridge Open Choice Network |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Maximum days supply of a first opioid fill for an opioid-naive member | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 |
| Opioid-naive lookback, calendar days with no paid opioid claim | 120 | 120 | 120 | 120 | 120 | 120 |
| Daily morphine milligram equivalent limit | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |

- A member with no paid opioid claim in the previous 120 calendar days is opioid-naive.
- The first opioid fill of an opioid-naive member is limited to a 7-day supply.
- An opioid claim above 90 morphine milligram equivalents per day rejects without a coverage review.
